seo.title: About
seo.description: Learn about Jadz Holdings LLC, founded by Don Banyong, and our mission to build businesses that make technology useful in everyday environments.

about.headline: Practical ideas. Connected businesses.
mainCopy: Jadz Holdings LLC is a US-registered holding company. Founded by Don Banyong, the company is developing ventures that bring digital platforms and coordinated services into everyday environments.
Our work begins with understanding how an experience operates today: the customer journey, the business process, the physical environment, and the opportunity for improvement.
From there, we develop software platforms, commercial models, and partnerships designed around those needs.

spaavs.legalRelationship: SPAAVS is the trading name for Jadz Smart Parking and Autonomous Vehicle Services, a subsidiary of Jadz Holdings LLC.
descriptions: SPAAVS is the trading name for Jadz Smart Parking and Autonomous Vehicle Services, a subsidiary of Jadz Holdings LLC. It is developing a platform that connects human drivers, parking facilities, vehicle-service providers, and fleet systems.

The planned experience brings together parking discovery, reservations, EV charging, selected vehicle services, and unified billing. Compatible fleet and autonomous-vehicle integrations form part of its development direction.
SPAAVS aims to work with existing parking facilities through partnerships, connecting available infrastructure with new service opportunities.
spaavs.developmentDisclaimer: Capabilities described here are in development and are not currently available as live services.
focusAreas: Future autonomous-ready capabilities at validated locations.
spaavs.partnershipModel: Parking facilities are approached as partners. SPAAVS is designed to connect available infrastructure with new service opportunities rather than requiring mandatory facility-software subscriptions as a commercial model.
